description: REQUIRES prior nps_edi__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Search workplace subscribers eligible for the NPS membership certificate (EC02) by name. Returns row_index/row_key per subscriber for the issue tool; never returns resident numbers.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

search_text.description: Subscriber name to search (srchData). Omit for the whole list.
